listing.name: D (D PC Port)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for D PC Port; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream describes game logic, pause and save states. v1.0.1 preserves older states; complete three-disc playthrough Unknown here. Windows package includes native game.dll; keep edition/disc set distinct from DOS D. Save states carry across v1.0.0-1.0.1 per upstream. Upstream platforms: Native Windows app documented. Exact CPU architecture beyond selected package/source docs Unknown; no retail BIOS required. Original data: PS1 D USA three discs SLUS-00128/00173/00174, own CUE/BIN images. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
